bio_en: Yervand Fndkian was born on 24 April 1894 in Krop, a village near Trabzon, and studied at the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin from 1910 to 1914. In 1915 he survived the massacre of his family by hiding in the mountains with a group of friends until the Russian army entered Trabzon. He became one of the circle of avengers around Misak Torlakian and Aram Yerkanian, and in 1975 published his recollections of the assassination of Khan Khoyski in Tiflis (1920). At Dro's invitation he later worked for eight years at the Ghukasov refinery in Ploiesti, Romania, and he died on 14 June 1978.
